summary: A 31-year-old Denver man fell 20-30 feet while climbing a boulder near Navajo Peak, struck his head and landed in a rocky crevasse; his companion attempted resuscitation and hiked about five miles to Brainard Lake for help; weather and darkness delayed a technical body recovery
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff, Boulder County Coroner, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
notes: 911 call from Pawnee Campground ~1:30 pm July 7; victim's girlfriend, a physician, attempted resuscitation [run 669: Mountain-Ear July-12-2018 print-edition roundup URL merged — corroborates the Navajo Peak fatal fall account; same story also covers Ruby Gulch lightning (companion-transported, excluded per convention) and the Camp Dick medical death (id 2762).]
